name: Attumen the Huntsman
summary: Two-phase fight. Phase 1: tank Midnight (the horse) while DPS burns it to 50%. Attumen spawns and merges with Midnight at 25%. Phase 2: tank the mounted Attumen, avoid Charge.

abilities.name: Shadow Cleave
abilities.desc: Frontal cleave. Tank faces boss away from raid.

abilities.name: Intangible Presence
abilities.desc: Curse that reduces hit chance by 50%. Decurse immediately.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.desc: Phase 2. Charges a random player. Stay spread, stay at range.

killers: Not decursing Intangible Presence — DPS and tanks miss everything
Standing in front of the boss (Shadow Cleave)
tips: Easy first boss. Good warm-up.
Drops mount (Fiery Warhorse) at ~1% rate.

name: Moroes
summary: Moroes comes with 4 random dinner guests (adds). CC as many as possible (shackle, trap, banish). Kill adds first, then burn Moroes. He applies an undispellable bleed (Garrote) that ticks until he dies or a Paladin uses Blessing of Protection.

abilities.name: Garrote
abilities.desc: Applies a bleed to a random player that deals 1000 damage every 3 sec for 5 min. Cannot be dispelled. Only removed by BoP, Stoneform, Ice Block, or killing Moroes.

abilities.name: Vanish
abilities.desc: Moroes vanishes and reappears with a Garrote on a random target. Healers must be ready.

abilities.name: Gouge
abilities.desc: Stuns the tank briefly. OT should be ready to taunt.

abilities.name: Blind
abilities.desc: Blinds a nearby player. Stay at range if possible.

killers: Garrote stacking on healers — if 3+ healers are garroted, the raid dies slowly
Adds getting loose — if CC breaks and adds go free, it's a wipe
No Paladin for BoP = Garrotes stay forever = healers OOM
prep: Bring a Paladin for Blessing of Protection to clear Garrote
Assign CC for each add before pull
tips: Priests can Shackle Undead the undead adds
Hunters can trap, Warlocks can banish (if Demon add is present)
Kill order on adds depends on which random set you get

name: Maiden of Virtue
type: Tank and spank with raid damage
summary: Stationary fight. She casts Holy Ground (consecration under her), Repentance (AoE stun on the whole raid), and Holy Fire on random players. Spread out, heal through the damage, interrupt nothing — just DPS and heal.

abilities.name: Holy Ground
abilities.desc: Consecration effect dealing ~240 Holy damage/sec + silence to anyone in melee range. Tank eats this.

abilities.name: Repentance
abilities.desc: AoE stun on the entire raid for 12 seconds. Deals ~2000 Holy damage over the duration. Breaks on damage — Holy Fire will break it.

abilities.name: Holy Fire
abilities.desc: Hits a random player for ~3500-4500 Holy damage and applies a DoT. This breaks Repentance. Will kill low-HP players if they're not healed.

abilities.name: Holy Wrath
abilities.desc: Chain lightning-style Holy damage that jumps between nearby players. Spread out to limit jumps.

killers: Repentance into Holy Fire — if you're low HP when stunned and get Holy Fired, you die
Holy Wrath chaining through stacked players
Healers must top everyone before Repentance hits
prep: Shadow Protection helps with nothing here — it's all Holy damage
Healthstones and HoTs before Repentance are key
tips: Spread out to avoid Holy Wrath chains
Paladins can Divine Shield out of Repentance to heal others
Dwarf Priests can Stoneform the Holy Fire DoT

name: Opera Event
summary: Random one of three encounters each lockout. Wizard of Oz: kill adds (Dorothee, Roar, Strawman, Tinhead) then The Crone. Romulo & Julianne: kill both within 10 sec of each other. Big Bad Wolf: kite the wolf when you get Little Red Riding Hood debuff.

abilities.name: Little Red Riding Hood (BBW)
abilities.desc: Turns a random player into Red Riding Hood — reduces armor to 0 and forces you to run. Wolf chases you. Run away or die.

abilities.name: Frightened Scream (Oz - Dorothee)
abilities.desc: AoE fear. Kill Dorothee first or keep her interrupted.

abilities.name: Cyclone (Oz - The Crone)
abilities.desc: Tosses a player into the air. Unavoidable, just heal through it.

abilities.name: Blinding Passion (R&J)
abilities.desc: Julianne heals. Interrupt or purge.

killers: BBW: Getting caught as Red Riding Hood — instant death if wolf reaches you
Oz: Not killing Dorothee first — fear chains wipe the raid
R&J: Not killing both within 10 sec — the survivor resurrects the other at full HP
tips: BBW: Sprint, Blink, or any movement ability saves lives when you're the wolf target
Oz kill order: Dorothee > Roar > Strawman > Tinhead > The Crone
R&J: Get both to ~5% then cleave them down together

name: The Curator
summary: Curator spawns Astral Flares every 10 sec that must be killed quickly. At 80% mana he goes Evocation (takes 200% damage for 20 sec). Burn hard during Evocation. He Hateful Strikes the highest HP target in melee.

abilities.name: Astral Flare
abilities.desc: Spawns a flare that chain-zaps nearby players for ~700 Arcane damage. Must be killed fast — they stack up.

abilities.name: Hateful Bolt
abilities.desc: Hits the highest HP target in the raid for ~4000-5000 Arcane damage. Soak with a tank or high-stam player.

abilities.name: Evocation
abilities.desc: At 80% mana, Curator channels for 20 sec, taking 200% damage. This is your burn window — pop cooldowns.

killers: Letting Flares stack — 3+ active flares = raid damage is unhealable
Missing the Evocation burn window — the fight becomes a mana war if you don't push phases
Squishies soaking Hateful Bolt — stay below tanks in HP
prep: Arcane resist is nice but not required
Assign ranged DPS to flare duty
tips: Save Heroism/Bloodlust for the first Evocation
Warlocks and Hunters are great flare killers
Drops T4 Glove tokens

name: Shade of Aran
type: No-tank caster boss with deadly mechanics
summary: No aggro table — attacks randomly. Three main mechanics to respect: Flame Wreath (DON'T MOVE), Blizzard (DO MOVE), and Arcane Explosion (run to the wall). He also Mass Polymorphs the raid and drinks to regen mana. If he reaches 20% he summons Water Elementals.

abilities.name: Flame Wreath
abilities.desc: Rings of fire around 3 players. If ANYONE moves through a ring, it explodes for ~5000 fire damage to the entire raid. Stand absolutely still for 20 sec.

abilities.name: Blizzard
abilities.desc: Rotating Blizzard around the room. Move out of it. Does NOT conflict with Flame Wreath (they don't overlap).

abilities.name: Arcane Explosion
abilities.desc: Slow-cast AoE. Run to the wall (max range). He pulls everyone in first with Magnetic Pull, then casts it. If you're close, you die.

abilities.name: Mass Polymorph
abilities.desc: Sheeps the entire raid and drinks to regen mana. DoTs on him break the sheep. Unavoidable.

abilities.name: Summon Water Elementals
abilities.desc: At 20% HP. Adds that spam Waterbolt. Burn the boss, don't worry about adds.

killers: Moving during Flame Wreath — the #1 wipe mechanic in all of Karazhan. DON'T MOVE.
Not running out for Arcane Explosion — one-shots anyone in melee range
Standing in Blizzard — it does a lot of damage and slows you
tips: If you have pets (Warlock, Hunter), dismiss them or they WILL walk through Flame Wreath
No tank needed — he's untauntable. Everyone spreads around the room.
Counterspell/interrupts don't work on his main abilities
Drops Tirisfal Wand of Ascendancy and Uni-Mind Headdress

name: Terestian Illhoof
summary: Illhoof sacrifices a random player (Demon Chains), dealing increasing damage until the chains are killed. He also spawns Imps constantly. AoE the imps, free sacrificed players fast, DPS the boss.

abilities.name: Sacrifice (Demon Chains)
abilities.desc: Teleports a random player to the center and chains them. Deals increasing Shadow damage until the chains (~6k HP) are destroyed. Player dies in ~8 sec if not freed.

abilities.name: Summon Fiendish Imp
abilities.desc: Constantly spawns imps that cast Firebolt. AoE them or they overwhelm healers.

abilities.name: Shadow Bolt Volley
abilities.desc: AoE Shadow damage to the raid. Frequent and steady — healers must keep up.

abilities.name: Kil'rek
abilities.desc: Demon add that buffs Illhoof. Kill him first, but he respawns. Kill him when he's up.

killers: Not freeing Sacrificed players in time — they die in 8 sec
Letting imps stack up — AoE classes need to be on it constantly
Healer getting sacrificed with no fast DPS on chains
prep: Seed of Corruption (Warlock) is amazing for imp control
Shadow resist helps with Shadow Bolt Volley but not required
tips: Assign 2-3 DPS to chain duty — they must swap immediately when someone gets sacrificed
Warlocks use Seed of Corruption on imps, it dominates this fight
Drops The Lightning Capacitor trinket

name: Netherspite
summary: Three colored beams connect portals to Netherspite. Players must stand in the beams to intercept them — if a beam reaches the boss unchecked, he powers up and wipes you. Red beam: tank soaks (increases HP). Green beam: healer soaks (increases healing). Blue beam: DPS soaks (increases damage). Rotate soakers because debuff stacks.

abilities.name: Red Beam (Perseverance)
abilities.desc: Increases HP and reduces damage dealt. Tank stands in this. Stacks reduce healing received — rotate tanks.

abilities.name: Green Beam (Serenity)
abilities.desc: Increases healing done and restores mana. Healer stands in this. Stacks reduce max HP — rotate healers.

abilities.name: Blue Beam (Dominance)
abilities.desc: Increases spell damage massively. DPS stands in this. Stacks reduce max HP — rotate DPS.

abilities.name: Netherbreath
abilities.desc: Frontal cone in Banish phase. Avoid being in front of him.

abilities.name: Banish Phase
abilities.desc: Every 30 sec, portals despawn for 30 sec. Boss is untargetable briefly. Beams return after.

killers: Nobody soaking a beam — boss absorbs it and becomes unhealable/unkillable
Blue beam soaker dying — they have massive spell damage but low HP from stacks. Heal them.
Not rotating soakers — debuff stacks eventually kill you
prep: Assign beam teams: 2 tanks for red, 2-3 healers for green, 2-3 DPS for blue
Practice the rotation before pulling
tips: Blue beam DPS does insane damage — time cooldowns with blue beam for massive burst
Warlocks and Shadow Priests are ideal blue beam soakers
This is one of the harder Kara fights. Coordination wins.

name: Nightbane
summary: Summoned boss (requires Blackened Urn quest). Ground phase: tank and spank with Charred Earth and Tail Sweep. Air phase at 75%, 50%, 25%: lands Smoking Blast on highest threat, rains Bone skeletons on the raid. Kill skeletons, avoid fire, burn when he lands.

abilities.name: Charred Earth
abilities.desc: Fire patch on the ground under a random player. Move out immediately.

abilities.name: Bellowing Roar
abilities.desc: AoE fear. Tremor Totem or Fear Ward helps. Breaks on damage.

abilities.name: Smoking Blast (Air Phase)
abilities.desc: Ranged attack on highest threat target during air phase. Tank must maintain threat and eat these with cooldowns.

abilities.name: Rain of Bones (Air Phase)
abilities.desc: Spawns Restless Skeleton adds. AoE them down before he lands.

killers: Standing in Charred Earth — fire patches persist and stack
Tank dying to Smoking Blast in air phase — must use cooldowns
Skeletons overwhelming healers if not AoE'd down before landing
prep: Requires Blackened Urn from Kara attunement quest chain to summon
Fire resist is helpful but not required
tips: Save AoE cooldowns for skeleton waves in air phase
Tank should build max threat before first air phase
Fear Ward on the tank before Bellowing Roar

name: Prince Malchezaar
summary: Three phases based on HP. Phase 1 (100-60%): easy, tank and spank. Phase 2 (60-30%): equips axes, hits much harder, applies Sunder Armor, drops Infernals randomly. Phase 3 (30-0%): drops axes, spams Shadow Nova and Amplify Damage. Infernals are the run-killer — if they drop on the raid, it's a wipe.

abilities.name: Enfeeble
abilities.desc: Reduces 5 random players to 1 HP for 8 sec. Heals back to full when it expires. Do NOT take any damage during Enfeeble or you die. Tank is immune.

abilities.name: Shadow Nova
abilities.desc: AoE Shadow damage centered on Prince. Ranged stay at 25+ yards. In Phase 3 he spams this.

abilities.name: Infernal
abilities.desc: Phase 2+. Drops an Infernal from the sky every 40 sec. It lands, does AoE fire damage in a radius, and stays. Cannot be killed. If it lands on the raid, reposition.

abilities.name: Sunder Armor (Phase 2)
abilities.desc: Stacks Sunder on tank. Hits very hard. Tank needs heavy healing.

abilities.name: Amplify Damage (Phase 3)
abilities.desc: Doubles damage taken by a random player. If combined with Shadow Nova, it's lethal.

killers: Infernal RNG — if Infernals drop on the tank or ranged camp, there's nowhere to go. Wipes happen.
Taking any damage during Enfeeble = instant death
Phase 2 tank damage — Sunder stacks + hard melee hits require heavy healing
Shadow Nova hitting melee in Phase 3 — stay spread
prep: Shadow resist gear helps in Phase 3 but isn't required
Tank needs max mitigation gear for Phase 2
tips: Position the fight at the edge of the terrace so Infernals have room to drop away from the raid
Tank near a wall so Infernals can't land behind you
Phase 2 is the hard part — if you survive it, Phase 3 is a burn
Drops T4 Helm token, Nathrezim Mindblade, Ruby Drape of the Mysticant

name: High King Maulgar
summary: Pull 5 mobs: Maulgar + 4 adds. Each add requires a dedicated tank or CC strategy. Kill adds in order, then burn Maulgar. Coordination on the pull is everything — most wipes happen in the first 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Arcing Smash (Maulgar)
abilities.desc: Frontal cleave. Main tank faces him away.

abilities.name: Whirlwind (Maulgar)
abilities.desc: AoE melee damage. Melee back out.

abilities.name: Krosh Firehand (Mage add)
abilities.desc: Casts Blast Wave and Greater Fireball (~9000 damage). A mage must Spellsteal his fire shield and tank him at range.

abilities.name: Olm the Summoner (Warlock add)
abilities.desc: Summons Felhounds and casts Death Coil. Enslave or kill pets, interrupt.

abilities.name: Kiggler the Crazed (Shaman add)
abilities.desc: Casts Lightning Bolt and Arcane Shock (knockback). Ranged-tanked by a hunter or lock.

abilities.name: Blindeye the Seer (Priest add)
abilities.desc: Heals the other adds. Must be interrupted or killed first.

killers: Bad pull — if tanks don't pick up their assigned add immediately, it's a wipe
Krosh Firehand without a mage to Spellsteal — his Fireball one-shots people
Blindeye healing adds back up — must be interrupted or killed first
Maulgar during Whirlwind — melee need to back out
prep: Assign tanks/CC for each add BEFORE the raid
Need a Mage for Krosh (Spellsteal tank)
Need a ranged tank (Hunter) for Kiggler
tips: Kill order: Blindeye > Olm > Kiggler > Krosh > Maulgar
This fight is 90% preparation, 10% execution
Drops T4 Shoulder tokens

name: Gruul the Dragonkiller
summary: Simple concept, hard execution. Gruul does increasing damage over time (Growth stacks). He periodically Shatters the raid — Ground Slam knocks everyone back, then Shatter deals damage based on proximity to other players. Spread out after Ground Slam or Shatter kills everyone.

abilities.name: Growth
abilities.desc: Every 30 sec, Gruul grows. Each stack increases damage by 10%. By 15+ stacks, he one-shots the tank. This is a soft enrage.

abilities.name: Ground Slam
abilities.desc: Knocks everyone back and stuns them briefly. Positions you randomly.

abilities.name: Shatter
abilities.desc: 5 sec after Ground Slam. Deals damage to every player based on how many other players are within 15 yards. If stacked, it one-shots. SPREAD OUT after Ground Slam.

abilities.name: Cave In
abilities.desc: Rocks fall on random locations. Move out of the dust clouds.

abilities.name: Reverberation
abilities.desc: Silences the raid for 4 sec. Healers need to pre-HoT.

killers: Shatter with players stacked — the #1 wipe mechanic. SPREAD after Ground Slam.
Growth stacking too high — if DPS is slow, the tank dies to melee hits around 12-15 stacks
Cave In — standing in falling rocks while stunned from Ground Slam
prep: This is a DPS check. Bring consumables, use Heroism early.
No specific resist gear needed
tips: After Ground Slam, immediately move away from other players before Shatter hits
The room is large — use all of it. Don't stack up.
Drops T4 Leg tokens and Dragonspine Trophy

name: Magtheridon
type: Add phase then burn with cube mechanic
summary: Phase 1: Kill 5 Channeler adds while Mag is banished. Phase 2: Mag activates — tank him and use the 5 Hellfire Channeling cubes to interrupt his Blast Nova (raid-wipe ability). 5 players click cubes simultaneously. Phase 3 (30%): cave collapses, avoid falling debris, burn him down.

abilities.name: Channelers (Phase 1)
abilities.desc: 5 Hellfire Channeler adds. Each casts Shadow Bolt Volley, Dark Mending (heal — interrupt this), and summons an Abyssal. Kill them in order before Mag activates at 2 minutes.

abilities.name: Blast Nova
abilities.desc: Phase 2. Mag channels a raid-wipe AoE. Must be interrupted by 5 players clicking the Hellfire Cubes simultaneously. If you miss it, everyone dies.

abilities.name: Quake
abilities.desc: Periodic knockback. Stuns briefly. Can interrupt cube clickers if timed badly.

abilities.name: Collapse (Phase 3)
abilities.desc: At 30%, ceiling collapses. Rocks fall dealing ~5000 damage. Avoid the shadow zones on the ground.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.desc: Frontal cleave. Tank faces away.

killers: Missing Blast Nova interrupt — if 5 people don't click cubes in time, it's an instant raid wipe
Channelers not dying before Mag activates — you get adds + boss = wipe
Cube clickers getting killed or Quaked off their cube during Blast Nova channel
Phase 3 cave collapse killing people who don't move out of debris zones
prep: Assign 5 cube clickers + backups. They MUST know their cube position.
Practice the cube click timing — all 5 must click within 1 sec of each other
Shadow resist helps for Channeler phase (Shadow Bolt Volley)
tips: Kill Channeler order: start with the two closest, work around the room
Cube clickers should be ranged DPS or healers — they need to survive and be mobile
Head quest reward (from Mag's head) is great — don't forget to loot it
Drops T4 Chest tokens
